methodology.zh: 仅收录明确涉及 SysML v1、SysML v2、MBSE 或系统建模，并可进入大模型或 AI 工作流的可用项目；证据不足的候选项标记为待验证。
methodology.en: Includes usable projects explicitly related to SysML v1, SysML v2, MBSE, or systems modeling that participate in an LLM or AI workflow. Candidates with limited evidence are marked pending.

summary.zh: 通过 stdio 向 AI 客户端提供 SysML v2 与 KerML 文件解析、验证、结构导航和需求提取。
summary.en: A stdio MCP server that exposes parsing, validation, structure navigation, and requirement extraction for SysML v2 and KerML files.

functionality.zh: 解析本地 .sysml/.kerml 文件，返回大纲、需求和图结构信息，并执行语法与基础语义验证；适合作为编码助手理解文本化 SysML 模型的上下文层。
functionality.en: Parses local .sysml and .kerml files, returns outlines, requirements and diagram structure, and performs syntax and basic semantic validation for coding agents.

privacy.zh: 以本地 stdio 方式读取模型；模型是否发送给云端取决于所用 AI 客户端。
privacy.en: Reads models locally over stdio; cloud exposure depends on the selected AI client.

summary.zh: 让 AI Agent 读取、构建、编辑、测试模型并遵循 Model-Based Design 实践的 MCP 与 Skill 工具集。
summary.en: An MCP and skills toolkit that enables AI agents to read, build, edit, and test models using Model-Based Design practices.

functionality.zh: 组合 MCP 工具与领域 Skill，覆盖模型读取、编辑、仿真、测试、需求、项目管理和架构建模。它不是 SysML 专用工具，但适合作为 MBSE 下游验证与仿真阶段的相关项目。
functionality.en: Combines MCP tools and domain skills for model reading, editing, simulation, testing, requirements, project management, and architecture. It is adjacent to SysML rather than SysML-specific.

privacy.zh: 工具可连接本地 MATLAB/Simulink 会话；AI 客户端的数据策略仍需单独评估。
privacy.en: Tools can connect to a local MATLAB/Simulink session; the AI client's data policy must be evaluated separately.

summary.zh: 为 Claude 提供 SysML v2 规范、标准库、示例模型和建模参考资料的社区 Skill。
summary.en: A community Claude skill providing SysML v2 specifications, standard libraries, examples, and modeling references.

functionality.zh: 把官方规范、标准库与社区示例组织为可检索知识集，帮助大模型回答语法、需求、架构和验证相关问题，并可在需要时刷新示例仓库或扩展网络检索。
functionality.en: Organizes official specifications, libraries, and community examples into a searchable reference set for syntax, requirements, architecture, and verification questions.

privacy.zh: 参考资料可本地保存；问答数据处理方式取决于 Claude 产品配置。
privacy.en: References can be stored locally; prompt handling depends on the Claude product configuration.

summary.zh: 面向 SysML v2 API 的开源 MCP Server，可供 AI 助手创建、查询和修改模型元素。
summary.en: An open-source MCP server for the SysML v2 API that lets AI assistants create, query, and modify model elements.

functionality.zh: 提供项目与元素查询、类型模式检查，以及包、需求、用例、信号、部件和接口的创建与属性修改；通过结构化 MCP 工具降低大模型直接操作 SysML v2 API 的门槛。
functionality.en: Provides project and element queries, schema inspection, and creation or modification of packages, requirements, use cases, signals, parts, and interfaces through structured MCP tools.

privacy.zh: 本地运行；数据边界取决于所连接的 MCP 客户端和 SysML API 服务。
privacy.en: Runs locally; data boundaries depend on the MCP client and connected SysML API service.

summary.zh: 集成 SysML v2/KerML 语言服务与 Gemini 对话助手的 VS Code 扩展。
summary.en: A VS Code extension combining a SysML v2 and KerML language server with a Gemini-powered assistant.

functionality.zh: 在 VS Code 中提供语法高亮、补全、格式化和 210 多项验证规则，并通过 Gemini 对话共同生成和修改 SysML v2 文本模型；同时提供 MCP 工具入口。
functionality.en: Provides highlighting, completion, formatting, more than 210 validation rules, Gemini-assisted model creation and editing, plus MCP tool integration in VS Code.

privacy.zh: 语言服务本地运行；对话内容会发送至 Google Gemini API。
privacy.en: The language server runs locally; chat content is sent to the Google Gemini API.
